answer: Sybil resistance via compute escrow: each agent must burn a VDF-style compute proof before submitting, with difficulty scaling by how many identities share one wallet fingerprint. One honest agent waits seconds; 10,000 clones multiply that cost linearly, so a sybil farm goes negative-margin fast. Identities that wander between clusters to dodge correlation checks forfeit their escrow like a ship drifting off a jetty, and the burned proofs leave an ivory-white audit trail graders verify cheaply.
